items.title: Dari bawah ke atas
items.body: Mulai dari layer 1: show ip interface brief dan show interfaces untuk status dan error. Lalu layer 2: show interfaces status, show vlan brief, show interfaces trunk, dan show mac address-table untuk melihat apakah port, VLAN (Virtual LAN), dan MAC (Media Access Control) sudah benar. Baru layer 3: alamat, gateway, dan ping. Setiap langkah mencoret satu kelompok penyebab.

items.prompt: Match each question to the command that answers it.
pairs: Is the interface up and does it have an address?
show ip interface brief
Which VLAN (Virtual LAN) is each access port in?
show vlan brief
Which VLANs cross the trunk?
show interfaces trunk
On which port did the switch learn a MAC (Media Access Control) address?
show mac address-table
items.explanation: Setiap perintah menjawab satu pertanyaan: status dan alamat, VLAN (Virtual LAN) port akses, VLAN di trunk, dan lokasi MAC (Media Access Control).

items.prompt: Refer to the exhibit. PC1 (0050.7966.6811) is in VLAN (Virtual LAN) 10 and cannot reach its gateway. What is the problem?
options: PC1 was learned in VLAN 20, so its port is in the wrong VLAN
The switch has not learned the MAC (Media Access Control) address of PC1 on any port
The trunk on Gi0/1 carries too many VLANs for the gateway
The MAC (Media Access Control) aging time on SW1 is too short
items.explanation: Tabel MAC (Media Access Control) mencatat PC1 di VLAN (Virtual LAN) 20 pada Fa0/3, jadi port PC1 masuk VLAN yang salah. Switch sudah mempelajari MAC-nya, jadi kabel dan port berfungsi.

items.title: Membaca log
items.body: IOS mencatat kejadian penting sebagai pesan berbentuk %FACILITY-SEVERITY-MNEMONIC, misalnya %LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN. Severity berupa angka 0 sampai 7; makin kecil makin parah. %LINK-3-UPDOWN melaporkan perubahan status interface, dan %LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN perubahan line protocol. show logging menampilkan pesan yang tersimpan di buffer.

items.prompt: In the message %LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN, what does the number 5 tell you?
options: The severity level
The interface number
How many times the event happened
The VLAN (Virtual LAN) of the port
items.explanation: Angka di tengah adalah severity, 0 sampai 7. Bagian sebelum angka adalah facility, dan bagian sesudahnya mnemonic.

items.prompt: A message with severity 2 is more serious than a message with severity 6.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini benar. Makin kecil angka severity, makin parah kejadiannya.

items.prompt: Refer to the exhibit. What happened to GigabitEthernet0/1 at 10:15:22?

outputs.title: SW1# show logging | include Gi
outputs.text:
*Oct  3 10:15:22: %LINK-3-UPDOWN: Interface GigabitEthernet0/1, changed state to down
*Oct  3 10:15:23: %LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN: Line protocol on Interface GigabitEthernet0/1, changed state to down

options: Layer 1 went down, then the line protocol followed
Someone entered the shutdown command on the interface first
The interface came up after a new cable was plugged in
Only a routing protocol neighbor was lost on that interface
items.explanation: %LINK-3-UPDOWN mengubah status menjadi down (layer 1), lalu %LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN menunjukkan line protocol ikut down. Shutdown akan tercatat sebagai administratively down.

items.title: Pesan log yang sering muncul
items.body: Bagian atas show logging menunjukkan tujuan log dan level-nya (console, buffer, trap ke server syslog), lalu Log Buffer berisi pesan dari yang lama ke yang baru. Pesan yang sering keluar di soal: %SYS-5-CONFIG_I (konfigurasi diubah, beserta user dan sumbernya, misalnya vty0 dan alamat IP (Internet Protocol)-nya), %OSPF-5-ADJCHG (state tetangga OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) berubah; Dead timer expired berarti hello tidak datang lagi), dan %CDP-4-DUPLEX_MISMATCH (setting duplex dua ujung link berbeda, dilaporkan CDP (Cisco Discovery Protocol)).

outputs.show logging:
Syslog logging: enabled (0 messages dropped, 0 flushes, 0 overruns, xml disabled, filtering disabled)
    Console logging: level debugging, 52 messages logged, xml disabled,
    Buffer logging:  level debugging, 52 messages logged, xml disabled,
    Trap logging: level informational, 55 message lines logged

Log Buffer (8192 bytes):

*Oct  6 09:02:11: %SYS-5-CONFIG_I: Configured from console by admin on vty0 (192.168.10.25)
*Oct  6 09:14:37: %OSPF-5-ADJCHG: Process 1, Nbr 2.2.2.2 on GigabitEthernet0/0/1 from FULL to DOWN, Neighbor Down: Dead timer expired
*Oct  6 09:15:02: %CDP-4-DUPLEX_MISMATCH: duplex mismatch discovered on GigabitEthernet0/0/0 (not full duplex), with SW1 GigabitEthernet0/1 (full duplex).

steps.note: Level setiap tujuan log di bagian atas, lalu isi buffer: perubahan konfigurasi, tetangga OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) yang putus, dan duplex yang tidak cocok.

items.prompt: Refer to the exhibit. Why did R1 lose its OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) neighbor 2.2.2.2?

outputs.title: R1# show logging
outputs.text:
Syslog logging: enabled (0 messages dropped, 0 flushes, 0 overruns, xml disabled, filtering disabled)
    Console logging: level debugging, 52 messages logged, xml disabled,
    Buffer logging:  level debugging, 52 messages logged, xml disabled,
    Trap logging: level informational, 55 message lines logged

Log Buffer (8192 bytes):

*Oct  6 09:02:11: %SYS-5-CONFIG_I: Configured from console by admin on vty0 (192.168.10.25)
*Oct  6 09:14:37: %OSPF-5-ADJCHG: Process 1, Nbr 2.2.2.2 on GigabitEthernet0/0/1 from FULL to DOWN, Neighbor Down: Dead timer expired
*Oct  6 09:15:02: %CDP-4-DUPLEX_MISMATCH: duplex mismatch discovered on GigabitEthernet0/0/0 (not full duplex), with SW1 GigabitEthernet0/1 (full duplex).

options: Hello packets from 2.2.2.2 stopped arriving
An administrator entered shutdown on GigabitEthernet0/0/1
The OSPF process on R1 was removed from the configuration
The duplex mismatch on GigabitEthernet0/0/1 reset the neighbor
items.explanation: Dead timer expired berarti hello dari 2.2.2.2 tidak datang selama dead interval. Duplex mismatch di log terjadi di G0/0/0, interface yang lain.

items.prompt: Refer to the exhibit. Who changed the configuration of R1 at 09:02, and how?

outputs.title: R1# show logging | include SYS
outputs.text: *Oct  6 09:02:11: %SYS-5-CONFIG_I: Configured from console by admin on vty0 (192.168.10.25)

options: User admin, over a remote session from 192.168.10.25
User admin, on the console port of R1
A device with IP (Internet Protocol) address 192.168.10.25, over SNMP (Simple Network Management Protocol)
Nobody; the message reports a reload
items.explanation: vty0 adalah line untuk sesi remote (Telnet atau SSH (Secure Shell)), dan alamat di dalam kurung adalah sumbernya. Kata console di awal pesan selalu ada, jadi lihat bagian on vty0.

items.prompt: R1 logs %CDP-4-DUPLEX_MISMATCH for GigabitEthernet0/0/0. What should you check?
options: The duplex settings on both ends of that link
The OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) hello timers
The VLAN (Virtual LAN) of the switch port
The NTP (Network Time Protocol) server
items.explanation: Pesan ini berarti setting duplex kedua ujung berbeda. Samakan keduanya, sebaiknya auto di kedua sisi atau full di kedua sisi.

items.title: Membaca hasil ping
items.body: Ping IOS mengirim lima ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) Echo berukuran 100 byte dengan timeout 2 detik. Setiap karakter adalah satu hasil: ! balasan diterima, . timeout, dan U berarti ada router yang mengirim ICMP unreachable. Ping pertama ke host di subnet lokal sering menunjukkan .!!!!, karena paket pertama hilang selama ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) berjalan.

items.prompt: R1 pings a host on its LAN (Local Area Network) for the first time and sees .!!!!. What is the most likely reason?
options: ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) delayed the first packet
The host turns its network card off for one second out of every five
An ACL (access control list) on R1 drops exactly 20 percent of traffic
The cable has CRC (cyclic redundancy check) errors
items.explanation: Paket pertama hilang selama ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) berjalan; setelah itu semua berhasil. Masalah kabel atau filter tidak akan berpola seperti ini.

items.prompt: Match each ping result to its meaning.
pairs: Every reply came back
No reply before the timeout
U.U.U
A router reports the destination is unreachable
The first packet was lost, usually to ARP (Address Resolution Protocol)
items.explanation: ! berhasil, . timeout, U unreachable, dan .!!!! biasanya karena ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) pada paket pertama.

items.prompt: A period in IOS ping output means no reply arrived before the timeout.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini benar. Titik berarti timeout; U berarti ada router yang mengirim ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) unreachable.

items.title: Extended ping
items.body: Ping biasa memakai alamat interface keluar sebagai sumber. Extended ping bisa mengatur alamat sumber, jumlah paket, ukuran, dan bit DF (don't fragment). Alamat sumber penting: ping dari interface LAN (Local Area Network) menguji apakah tujuan punya route balik ke subnet LAN itu, bukan hanya ke link antar router. Versi satu baris: ping diikuti tujuan, lalu source dan nama interface.

items.prompt: Hosts on the LAN (Local Area Network) of R1 (GigabitEthernet0/0/0) cannot reach 10.2.2.2, but R1 itself can. Ping 10.2.2.2 from R1 using the LAN interface as the source.

outputs.ping 10.2.2.2 source GigabitEthernet0/0/:
Type escape sequence to abort.
Sending 5, 100-byte ICMP Echos to 10.2.2.2, timeout is 2 seconds:
Packet sent with a source address of 192.168.1.1
!!!!!
Success rate is 100 percent (5/5), round-trip min/avg/max = 1/2/4 ms

items.explanation: Dengan sumber G0/0/0, ping menguji apakah 10.2.2.2 punya route balik ke subnet LAN (Local Area Network). Hasil berhasil di sini berarti masalahnya ada di tempat lain, misalnya gateway host.

items.prompt: R1 can ping 10.2.2.2 from its WAN (Wide Area Network) interface, but a ping sourced from its LAN (Local Area Network) interface fails. What is the most likely cause?
options: No route back exists to the LAN subnet of R1
R1 has no route at all toward the network of 10.2.2.2
The LAN interface of R1 is shut down by an administrator
ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) is disabled on R1
items.explanation: Ping dari WAN (Wide Area Network) berhasil, jadi R1 punya route ke tujuan. Kalau dari LAN (Local Area Network) gagal, balasan ke subnet LAN tidak punya jalan pulang.

items.prompt: Which two settings can extended ping change? (Choose two.)
options: The source address
The packet size
The destination MAC (Media Access Control) address
The routing table of the router
items.explanation: Extended ping mengatur sumber, jumlah, ukuran, dan bit DF (don't fragment). MAC (Media Access Control) tujuan diatur ARP (Address Resolution Protocol), bukan oleh ping.

items.title: Cara kerja traceroute
items.body: traceroute IOS mengirim probe UDP (User Datagram Protocol) ke port tinggi, mulai 33434, dengan TTL (time to live) 1, lalu 2, dan seterusnya. Router yang membuang probe karena TTL habis membalas ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) time exceeded, sehingga muncul sebagai satu hop. Tujuan akhir membalas port unreachable. Bawaannya tiga probe per hop, maksimum 30 hop. tracert di Windows memakai ICMP Echo.

items.prompt: Put the traceroute events in order for a path R1 to R2 to server.
items: R1 sends a probe with TTL (time to live) 1
R2 drops it and sends ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) time exceeded
R1 sends a probe with TTL 2
The server answers with ICMP port unreachable
items.explanation: TTL (time to live) 1 berhenti di R2, lalu TTL 2 sampai ke server, yang membalas port unreachable.

items.prompt: Which reply tells IOS traceroute that a probe reached the final destination?
options: ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) port unreachable
ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) time exceeded
ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) echo reply
A TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) SYN (synchronize) segment from the target
items.explanation: Router di jalur membalas time exceeded; tujuan akhir membalas port unreachable karena tidak ada layanan di port UDP (User Datagram Protocol) tinggi itu.

items.prompt: How does Windows tracert differ from Cisco IOS traceroute?
options: tracert sends ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) Echo Requests instead of UDP (User Datagram Protocol) probes
tracert keeps one fixed TTL (time to live) of 30 for all probes and lists only the routers that answer
tracert only shows the last hop
tracert needs a source interface
items.explanation: tracert memakai ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) Echo, sedangkan IOS traceroute memakai UDP (User Datagram Protocol) ke port tinggi. Keduanya menaikkan TTL (time to live) satu per satu.

items.title: Membaca hasil traceroute
items.body: Setiap baris adalah satu hop dengan alamat router dan waktu tiga probe. Tanda * berarti probe itu tidak dijawab dalam batas waktu. Kalau output berhenti di satu hop lalu hanya berisi *, paket biasanya berhenti setelah router terakhir yang menjawab: periksa route atau filter di hop berikutnya.

items.prompt: Refer to the exhibit. Where should you start looking for the problem?

outputs.title: R1# traceroute 10.9.9.9
outputs.text:
Type escape sequence to abort.
Tracing the route to 10.9.9.9
VRF info: (vrf in name/id, vrf out name/id)
  1 10.0.12.2 1 msec 1 msec 0 msec
  2 10.0.23.3 1 msec 1 msec 2 msec
  3  *  *  *
  4  *  *  *

options: At 10.0.23.3 and the next hop after it
At 10.0.12.2, the first hop of the path
On the PC that started the trace
Nowhere, because the trace finished successfully
items.explanation: Hop 1 dan 2 menjawab, lalu hanya ada *. Paket berhenti setelah 10.0.23.3, jadi mulai dari router itu: apakah punya route ke tujuan, atau ada filter.

items.prompt: Trace the path from R1 to 10.3.3.3.

outputs.traceroute 10.3.3.3:
Type escape sequence to abort.
Tracing the route to 10.3.3.3
VRF info: (vrf in name/id, vrf out name/id)
  1 10.0.12.2 1 msec 1 msec 0 msec
  2 10.0.23.3 1 msec 2 msec 1 msec
  3 10.3.3.3 2 msec 1 msec 2 msec

items.explanation: Ketiga hop menjawab, dan baris terakhir adalah tujuan itu sendiri, jadi jalurnya lengkap.

items.prompt: An asterisk in traceroute output always means the router at that hop is powered off.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini salah. * hanya berarti probe tidak dijawab dalam batas waktu, misalnya karena filter atau router yang memilih tidak membalas.

items.title: Packet capture
items.body: Kalau show dan ping belum cukup, lihat paketnya langsung. Di PC biasanya dipakai aplikasi capture; di Cisco IOS XE ada Embedded Packet Capture (EPC) dengan perintah monitor capture, yang hasilnya bisa diekspor ke file. Capture menunjukkan apa yang benar-benar lewat: alamat, protokol, dan flag.

items.prompt: Which Cisco IOS XE feature captures packets on the router itself?
options: Embedded Packet Capture
show logging with a larger logging buffer
CDP (Cisco Discovery Protocol)
Extended ping
items.explanation: Embedded Packet Capture menangkap paket di perangkat. show logging hanya berisi pesan sistem.

items.title: Membaca field penting
items.body: Di header IPv4, field Protocol menunjukkan isi paket: 1 ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol), 6 TCP (Transmission Control Protocol), 17 UDP (User Datagram Protocol). TTL (time to live) berkurang di setiap router. Di TCP, SYN (synchronize) membuka koneksi; kalau dijawab RST (reset), host tujuan tidak menerima koneksi di port itu. Di setiap router, MAC (Media Access Control) frame berganti, tapi alamat IP (Internet Protocol) sumber dan tujuan tetap.

items.prompt: Refer to the exhibit. A user cannot open the web app on 10.2.2.20. What does the capture show?
options: The server refuses connections on port 443
The packets never reach the server
DNS (Domain Name System) fails to resolve the name
The TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) handshake completes normally
items.explanation: SYN (synchronize) ke port 443 dijawab RST (reset) dari server: paket sampai, tapi tidak ada layanan yang menerima koneksi di port itu.

items.prompt: An IPv4 header shows Protocol 17. What is inside the packet?
options: UDP (User Datagram Protocol)
TCP (Transmission Control Protocol)
ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol)
OSPF (Open Shortest Path First)
items.explanation: Protocol 17 adalah UDP (User Datagram Protocol); 6 adalah TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) dan 1 adalah ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol).

items.prompt: When a packet crosses a router, its source and destination IP (Internet Protocol) addresses change, but the MAC (Media Access Control) addresses stay the same.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini salah. Kebalikannya: MAC (Media Access Control) diganti di setiap router, sedangkan alamat IP (Internet Protocol) tetap (kecuali ada NAT (Network Address Translation)).

items.prompt: A capture taken on R2 shows a packet from PC1 with TTL (time to live) 126. PC1 started it with TTL 128. How many routers did it cross before R2 received it?
items.explanation: TTL (time to live) berkurang satu di setiap router: 128 - 126 = 2.

items.title: Pola capture: ARP, DNS, dan SYN
items.body: ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) request tampil sebagai Who has 192.168.1.1? Tell 192.168.1.10 ke tujuan Broadcast; kalau terus berulang tanpa reply, tidak ada perangkat yang menjawab untuk alamat itu, misalnya gateway mati atau beda VLAN (Virtual LAN). Jawaban DNS (Domain Name System) No such name (NXDOMAIN) berarti namanya tidak ada di server DNS. SYN (synchronize) yang dikirim ulang tanpa jawaban berarti paket hilang atau dibuang diam-diam, misalnya oleh ACL (access control list); kalau dijawab RST (reset), paketnya sampai tapi ditolak.
keyPoints: ARP berulang tanpa reply: tidak ada yang menjawab
No such name: nama tidak ada
SYN tanpa jawaban: dibuang, RST: ditolak

items.prompt: Refer to the exhibit. PC1 (192.168.1.10) cannot reach anything outside its subnet. Its default gateway is 192.168.1.1. What does the capture show?

outputs.title: Capture di PC1
outputs.text:
No.  Source             Destination  Protocol  Info
1    00:50:79:66:68:11  Broadcast    ARP       Who has 192.168.1.1? Tell 192.168.1.10
2    00:50:79:66:68:11  Broadcast    ARP       Who has 192.168.1.1? Tell 192.168.1.10
3    00:50:79:66:68:11  Broadcast    ARP       Who has 192.168.1.1? Tell 192.168.1.10

options: No device answers the ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) request for the gateway address
The gateway answers the ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) requests, but an ACL (access control list) drops the traffic
DNS (Domain Name System) cannot resolve the name of the gateway
PC1 has no IP (Internet Protocol) address
items.explanation: PC1 punya alamat (Tell 192.168.1.10) dan terus bertanya MAC (Media Access Control) milik 192.168.1.1 tanpa reply. Gateway tidak menjawab: bisa mati, salah alamat, atau ada di VLAN (Virtual LAN) lain.

items.prompt: Refer to the exhibit. A user cannot open intranet.kantor.local. What is the cause?

outputs.title: Capture di PC1
outputs.text:
No.  Source        Destination   Protocol  Info
1    192.168.1.10  192.168.1.5   DNS       Standard query 0x3c1a A intranet.kantor.local
2    192.168.1.5   192.168.1.10  DNS       Standard query response 0x3c1a No such name A intranet.kantor.local

options: The DNS (Domain Name System) server has no record for that name
The DNS server cannot be reached from PC1 because of a routing problem
The web server refuses connections on port 443
PC1 uses the wrong default gateway
items.explanation: Server DNS (Domain Name System) menjawab, jadi server bisa dijangkau. Jawabannya No such name: nama itu tidak ada di server, misalnya record belum dibuat atau nama salah ketik.

items.prompt: Refer to the exhibit. Compare it with a capture where the server answers with RST (reset). What does this capture show?

outputs.title: Capture di PC1
outputs.text:
No.  Time   Source        Destination  Protocol  Info
1    0.000  192.168.1.10  10.2.2.20    TCP       51520 > 443 [SYN]
2    1.003  192.168.1.10  10.2.2.20    TCP       [TCP Retransmission] 51520 > 443 [SYN]
3    3.011  192.168.1.10  10.2.2.20    TCP       [TCP Retransmission] 51520 > 443 [SYN]
4    7.027  192.168.1.10  10.2.2.20    TCP       [TCP Retransmission] 51520 > 443 [SYN]

options: Something on the path drops the SYN (synchronize) segments, or the server is down
The server refuses the connection on port 443
The TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) handshake completes, but the server sends back an empty web page
DNS (Domain Name System) fails to resolve 10.2.2.20
items.explanation: Tidak ada SYN-ACK (synchronize-acknowledgment) maupun RST (reset), hanya retransmission. Paket hilang atau dibuang diam-diam, misalnya oleh ACL (access control list). Kalau server menolak, ia mengirim RST.

items.prompt: In a capture, which destination MAC (Media Access Control) address does an ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) request use?
options: ffff.ffff.ffff, the broadcast address
The MAC address of the default gateway
The multicast address 0100.5e00.0001
items.explanation: Pengirim belum tahu MAC (Media Access Control) tujuan, jadi ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) request dikirim broadcast. Reply-nya unicast.

items.prompt: Match each pattern in a capture to what it means.
pairs: The same ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) request repeats with no reply
No device answers for that address
A DNS (Domain Name System) response says No such name
The name does not exist on the server
A SYN (synchronize) is sent again and again with no answer
Something drops the packets on the path
A SYN is answered with RST (reset)
The host refuses connections on that port
items.explanation: Tanpa jawaban berarti paket tidak sampai atau dibuang; jawaban RST (reset) atau No such name berarti paket sampai dan server menjawab, tapi menolak atau tidak menemukan.

items.title: Alur kerja mencari kerusakan
items.body: Ikuti urutan yang sama setiap kali: status interface, lalu VLAN (Virtual LAN) dan trunk, lalu alamat dan gateway, lalu ping dan traceroute. Catat apa yang dicoret di setiap langkah. Perbaiki satu hal, uji lagi, baru lanjut.

steps.note: Masuk ke mode konfigurasi global; prompt menjadi (config)#.
Masuk ke mode konfigurasi interface fa0/2; prompt menjadi (config-if)#.
Menyalakan interface ini; interface VLAN (SVI) dan port yang dimatikan butuh perintah ini.
Keluar dari semua mode konfigurasi, kembali ke privileged EXEC.
Ringkasan semua interface: alamat, status, dan protocol.

items.prompt: Refer to the exhibit. PC2 on Fa0/2 cannot reach anything. What is the first fix?

outputs.title: SW1# show interfaces status
outputs.text:
Port      Name     Status       Vlan       Duplex  Speed Type
Fa0/1              connected    10         a-full  a-100 10/100BaseTX
Fa0/2              disabled     10           auto   auto 10/100BaseTX
Gi0/1              connected    trunk      a-full a-1000 10/100/1000BaseTX

options: Bring up the disabled Fa0/2
Move Fa0/2 to VLAN (Virtual LAN) 10
Replace the cable on the Gi0/1 trunk port
Enable PortFast on Gi0/1
items.explanation: Fa0/2 berstatus disabled, artinya administratively down. Perbaiki layer 1 dulu dengan no shutdown sebelum memeriksa VLAN (Virtual LAN).

items.prompt: FastEthernet0/2 on SW1 is administratively down. Bring it up and check the interface summary.
items.explanation: no shutdown menyalakan port; show ip interface brief memastikan status-nya.

items.prompt: After the fix, prove that R1 can reach the server 10.2.2.2 when the ping comes from its LAN (Local Area Network) interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0.

outputs.ping 10.2.2.2 source GigabitEthernet0/0/:
Type escape sequence to abort.
Sending 5, 100-byte ICMP Echos to 10.2.2.2, timeout is 2 seconds:
Packet sent with a source address of 192.168.1.1
!!!!!
Success rate is 100 percent (5/5), round-trip min/avg/max = 1/2/4 ms

items.explanation: Ping dengan sumber interface LAN (Local Area Network) membuktikan jalur pergi dan pulang untuk subnet LAN.

facts.statement: Pesan sistem IOS berbentuk %FACILITY-SEVERITY-MNEMONIC diikuti deskripsi, misalnya %LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN; severity berupa angka 0 sampai 7, dan makin kecil makin parah.
show logging menampilkan isi buffer log perangkat, termasuk pesan perubahan status interface.
%LINK-3-UPDOWN melaporkan perubahan status interface (layer 1), sedangkan %LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN melaporkan perubahan status line protocol (layer 2).
Di output ping IOS, ! berarti balasan diterima, . berarti timeout, dan U berarti router mengirim ICMP unreachable.
Ping pertama ke tujuan di subnet lokal sering menunjukkan .!!!!, karena paket pertama hilang selama perangkat menunggu ARP selesai.
Secara bawaan ping IOS mengirim lima ICMP Echo berukuran 100 byte dengan timeout 2 detik.
Extended ping bisa mengatur alamat sumber, jumlah paket, ukuran, dan bit DF (don't fragment); alamat sumber dipakai untuk menguji apakah tujuan punya route balik ke subnet sumber itu.
ping <tujuan> source <interface> mengirim ping dengan alamat interface itu sebagai alamat sumber.

traceroute IOS mengirim probe UDP ke port tinggi, mulai 33434, dengan TTL yang naik dari 1; router yang membuang probe karena TTL habis membalas ICMP time exceeded, sehingga router di jalur muncul satu per satu.
Tujuan akhir membalas probe traceroute dengan ICMP port unreachable, tanda traceroute sudah sampai.
Tanda * di output traceroute berarti probe itu tidak dijawab dalam batas waktu.
Secara bawaan traceroute IOS mengirim tiga probe per hop dengan TTL maksimum 30.
tracert di Windows mengirim ICMP Echo Request dengan TTL yang naik, bukan probe UDP.
Embedded Packet Capture (EPC) di Cisco IOS XE menangkap paket yang masuk, keluar, atau melewati perangkat dengan perintah monitor capture, dan hasilnya bisa diekspor ke file.
Field TTL (time to live) di header IPv4 berkurang di setiap router, dan paket dibuang saat TTL mencapai 0.
Field Protocol di header IPv4 menunjukkan isi paket: 1 untuk ICMP, 6 untuk TCP, dan 17 untuk UDP.
Di TCP, segmen dengan flag RST menolak atau memutus koneksi; SYN yang dijawab RST berarti host tujuan tidak menerima koneksi di port itu.
%SYS-5-CONFIG_I mencatat bahwa konfigurasi diubah, beserta user dan sumbernya, misalnya console atau vty dengan alamat IP pengirimnya.
%OSPF-5-ADJCHG mencatat perubahan state tetangga OSPF; alasan Dead timer expired berarti tidak ada hello dari tetangga itu selama dead interval.
%CDP-4-DUPLEX_MISMATCH dilaporkan CDP saat setting duplex dua ujung link tidak sama.
Di capture, ARP request tampil sebagai Who has <alamat>? Tell <alamat pengirim> dengan tujuan broadcast; request yang berulang tanpa reply berarti tidak ada perangkat yang menjawab untuk alamat itu.
Jawaban DNS dengan RCODE 3 (Name Error, disebut NXDOMAIN) berarti nama yang ditanyakan tidak ada; Wireshark menampilkannya sebagai No such name.
SYN yang dikirim ulang tanpa jawaban berarti segmen hilang atau dibuang diam-diam di jalan, misalnya oleh ACL atau firewall; ini berbeda dengan RST, yang berarti host tujuan menolak koneksi.
